entities.name: Santa Teresa degli Scalzi, Naples
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Santa Teresa degli Scalzi is a church in Naples, Italy, located in via Santa Teresa degli Scalzi, a wide street opened during 1806–1810, to connect the historic center of Naples to the zone of Capodimonte. The church is generally closed to the public.
